messages:
sophie: quick copy check for the Dedicated Pools empty state when autoscaling hasn't been configured. want something helpful and low-friction for new users. current text below.

sophie: Current empty state draft:
Heading: No autoscale policy yet
Body: Your pool isn't configured to autoscale. Create a policy to automatically add capacity.
Primary: Create policy
Secondary: Learn more

sophie: concerns: 'policy' might be confusing, and 'add capacity' is vague. also want a friendly tone and a clear benefit line (cost/latency).

amar: +1. maybe swap 'policy' for 'autoscale policy' the first time, then shorten. suggest explicit benefit: 'Reduce latency spikes and avoid throttling'.

amar: alternative:
Heading: No autoscale policy configured
Body: Autoscaling helps keep latency low during traffic spikes and saves cost when idle. Create an autoscale policy to start.
Primary: Create autoscale policy
Secondary: View docs

tia: i'd keep the primary CTA shorter for buttons: 'Create policy' is fine if we clarify in the body. also consider progressive disclosure: show a short example config line in the empty state (like min/max).

tia: example inline snippet suggestion:
`min: 1
max: 8
metric: p99_latency`

lee: accessibility note: heading should be descriptive for screen readers. avoid starting headings with 'No'. prefer action-first headings: 'Set up autoscaling for this pool'. screen readers and SEO benefit from verbs.

lee: suggestion rewrite:
Heading: Set up autoscaling for this pool
Body: Autoscaling adjusts capacity based on traffic to reduce latency spikes and save costs. Start with a simple policy (e.g., min 1, max 8).
Primary: Create policy
Secondary: Learn about autoscaling

a11y-bot: a11y checklist: ensure the inline code snippet has role="region" and aria-label="example autoscale policy"; links must have descriptive text; primary CTA should have aria-label reflecting the action and pool name when possible (e.g., "Create autoscale policy for pool-3"). keyboard focus order must include the primary CTA.

sophie: great points. i'm leaning to combine Lee's action-first heading + Amar's benefit line + Tia's short snippet. final candidate:

Heading: Set up autoscaling for this pool
Body: Autoscaling adjusts capacity to reduce latency spikes and save costs. Start with a simple policy like: `min: 1  max: 8`
Primary: Create policy
Secondary: Learn about autoscaling

sophie: tiny UX nit: for very small screens maybe hide the example and show a tiny CTA-only view: "Set up autoscaling". also add a small microcopy under primary: "Recommended for production workloads".

amar: :thumbsup: microcopy nit: prefer sentence case for body and microcopy (we use sentence case elsewhere).

tia: dev note: suggest exposing an autofill that pre-populates the policy modal with min/max from the snippet when users hit 'Create policy'. saves friction.

lee: accessibility follow-up: add aria-describedby linking the microcopy and ensure the example snippet is keyboard-focusable. also avoid relying on color to convey recommended status.

sophie: i'll update the Figma with the action-first heading, benefit line, snippet, and microcopy under the CTA. i'll add aria-label and dev notes for autofill. pinging PM after updates. if no objections by EOD react or reply. :sparkles:

amar: LGTM

tia: +1

lee: looks good to me.
